## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      2 avis récents mentionnent prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 3 août 2026 - 22 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Bib Basters_, 22 sept. 2026, 1/5: "1 minute in the app and I have already hit a paywall. switched to other app"
            2. _Anthony Taylor_, 3 août 2026, 1/5: "I chose Habitify and prepaid for a full year of Premium because it showed an overall daily completion score across my habits and categories. After the update, weekly and monthly habits no longer count, so my score shows 0%. Support confirmed this is intentional. Removing the main feature customers paid for during an active annual subscription is ridiculous and deeply disappointing. Unless it is restored, I will cancel and switch apps."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      2 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 10 mars 2026 - 22 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Tom_, 15 août 2026, 1/5: "bought a lifetime membership, doesn't seem to equate to lifetime development. the app has noticably degraded in terms of performance and bugs"
            2. _Alexander Husted_, 10 mars 2026, 1/5: "After using the app for a while, and paying for lifetime membership, I started having bugs which made the app unusable. I wrote to support, but haven't received an answer. I run it in on a Galaxy S21 with Android 15"
            3. _Alexander Husted_, 22 sept. 2026, 3/5: "After using the app for a while, and paying for lifetime membership, I started having bugs which made the app unusable. I wrote to support, but haven't received an answer. I run it in on a Galaxy S21 with Android 15. Update: They fixed the issue that I had, but new ones have been created. I cannot update the of habits, effectivly making it unusable."
<!--/ir-theme-->
